written_before: any 2x2 arm result or any scored oracle call was read
why_predeclared: A threshold chosen after seeing the numbers is not a threshold. Both rules below are fixed here and the freeze/promote decision quotes them verbatim.

step_1_zero_oracle_2x2.question: Which of the four scale x content arms is the mechanism to freeze?
step_1_zero_oracle_2x2.selection_among_eligible_arms: the arm that closes the most of the census gap, scored as the mean of the three normalised axis closures: frac_largest_region_ge_13 toward 0.583, median_largest_changed_region toward 14, frac_installs_ring toward 0.806. Ties break toward the SIMPLER arm (fewer axes changed).
step_1_zero_oracle_2x2.abort: If no arm passes both eligibility gates, freeze nothing and report that the completion repair costs more yield or diversity than it buys.

step_2_scored_ab.arms: A = deployed B (online memory ON, completion law ABSENT); B = identical plus the frozen completion law
step_2_scored_ab.secondary_metric: top-10 mean of the charged sequence at checkpoints 100, 150, 200, 250
step_2_scored_ab.QUALIFY: B_auc >= 1.10 * A_auc AND B leads A on the top-10 mean at >= 3 of the 4 checkpoints
step_2_scored_ab.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else -- report it, and do NOT spend the qualification-panel budget
step_2_scored_ab.validity_check_not_an_outcome_gate: Arm B must contain at least one charged proposal whose module parameters carry completion == 'component' or requested_size > 8. Zero means the law was INERT and the comparison is VOID rather than negative.
caveats_to_state_with_any_result: one task, one seed, 250 calls: this justifies or refuses the next scaling step, it is not a benchmark claim
top_auc trapezoids from (0,0), so a 250-call AUC is structurally depressed ~20% at a constant level and must never be compared to a published 10k figure
both arms run locally on the pinned PMO kernel, not in the deployed Modal image

step_3_qualification_panel.frozen: the SAME controller, byte-identical; no tuning between tasks
step_3_qualification_panel.jnk3_precondition: jnk3 is asset-backed with an EAGER relative-path load at construction. Its asset must resolve for the oracle's whole lifetime and a positive control must CALL it on known actives before the first charged call.
